messages:
claire-peopleops: Quick Q  - We're switching payroll providers mid-year; will that change timing for 401(k) employer match deposits or cause duplicate FSA pre-tax deductions? Trying to give managers a clear note for new hires and ongoing leaves.
dan-eng: good flag. payroll cutover weeks are messy. vendor docs?
margo-finance: Payroll migration can cause timing shifts. Match is remitted by payroll/finance to the recordkeeper; if there's a lag we may need manual remittance to avoid missed matches. FSA deductions are payroll elections and could double-deduct if both systems process the same paycheck during cutover.
benefits@redwood: Confirmed with recordkeeper: they need consistent payroll files. If payroll runs twice for a pay period and both files include deferral lines, vendor will likely reconcile duplicates but that takes time and may show as duplicate contributions on statements until corrected. Best practice: instruct payroll to suspend recurring benefits deductions for the cutover pay cycle and run reconciled file.
payroll-bot: Action: payroll migration checklist step - pause pre-tax deductions for cutover pay cycle and export year-to-date deduction totals for benefits reconciliation. Link: internal migration playbook.
claire-peopleops: So action items for managers/people ops: 1) notify employees to expect a short pause for pre-tax deductions during the cutover, 2) benefits to coordinate with payroll to prevent double deductions, 3) finance to plan for manual match remittance if automated file misses a cycle.
margo-finance: We'll draft the comms and a one-page FAQ for managers. Also opening a vendor case with recordkeeper to confirm deadlines for remittance to avoid vesting/match gaps. Case# RK-2026-5591.
benefits@redwood: We'll post the FAQ to the benefits portal and flag any employees currently on leave so we can ensure their deductions/match are handled correctly.
claire-peopleops: thanks everyone  :thumbsup:
